stem: What is the most effective way to revise sentence 32?

options.label: A
options.text: In late spring the sides of the cliffs echo with the music of tiny tree frogs.

options.label: B
options.text: In late spring the sides of the cliffs echo with the music of tiny tree frogs, and it is music.

options.label: C
options.text: In late spring the sides of the cliffs echo with the musical echoes of tiny tree frogs.

options.label: D
options.text: In late spring the sides of the cliffs echo music, and it is the music of tiny tree frogs.
